Assistance to and Protection of Victims: Crime and Witnesses Act, No. 10 of 2023
to set out duties and responsibilities of the State,
judicial officers and public officers in upholding,

promoting 
and  protecting 
the 
rights 
and
entitlements of victims of crime and witnesses;
to stipulate conduct that constitute offences against
victims of crime and witnesses;
to provide assistance and protection to victims of
crime and witnesses;
to provide for a mechanism to enable the victims of
crime and witnesses to exercise and enforce their
rights and entitlements and to obtain relief;
to  provide  for  the  granting  of  redress  including

compensation, 
restitution, 
reparation 
and
rehabilitation to victims of crime and witnesses;
to establish a National Authority for the Protection
of Victims of Crime and Witnesses and a Victims of
Crime  and  Witnesses  Assistance  and  Protection
Division;
to  make  provision  for  the  victims  of  crime  and
witnesses  to  testify  through  contemporaneous
audio-visual means; and
to  recognize  and  implement  internationally
recognized best practices relating to assistance to
and protection of victims of crime and witnesses.
